population: All 45 previously scored EMPTY_NEUTRAL_CAPTURE cases, retaining 13 inventory MATCH and 32 zero-inventory MISMATCH; original development/holdout split unchanged. This is retrospective diagnosis, not fresh holdout or certification.

hypotheses.H1: Zero inventory may be associated with a compatible outgoing visible from captured target in offsets 0..2. Auxiliary only; MATCH need not have no outgoing.
hypotheses.H2: Primary: inventory at arrival may equal incoming minus all newly observed same-owner outgoing vectors at arrival. No cherry-picked subset of outgoing forces. Window 0..2 accounting is supplementary lagged association, not a same-tick forecast.
hypotheses.H3: Automatic relay, existing multi-leg continuation, immediate relaunch, or other cause unresolved; no causal attribution.
hypotheses.OWNER_ONLY_CAPTURE: Empty neutral ordinary established arrival -> owner_after=incoming_owner. Hypothesis only; production requires new recording acquired after this freeze, >=10 qualifying groups / >=2 contexts / >=90% owner accuracy / no unexplained high-impact mismatch.

time: arrival=a, offset0=a, offset1=a+1, offset2=a+2; before=a-1. Do not confuse the prior fixture following=a+1 with a+2. Exact same document/match/player/time-origin scope and consecutive ticks; use first retained observation per tick. Missing states remain UNKNOWN.
outgoing: List all visible forces whose known source equals captured target, including owner/vector/destination/progress and supplemental observer ID. Compatible means owner equals new owner and nonzero typed vector componentwise <=incoming. Accounting includes all newly observed same-owner source-target vectors, not only compatible vectors; oversized vectors remain counterexamples. Destination may be UNKNOWN and must not be guessed. Wrong-owner forces are retained but not subtracted.
first_appearance: First observable source/owner/vector/destination signature after before. Subtract already-present before signature multiplicities. Deduplicate a persisting signature across offset snapshots; simultaneous same-signature multiplicity is retained and duplicate/genealogy ambiguity reported. Observer ID alone cannot prove birth. Before unknown-endpoint aliases are explicitly reported as uncertain first appearance; first visible is not launch time.
accounting: Primary compares incoming - sum(new same-owner visible outgoing at offset0) with observed inventory at offset0. Report exact/mismatch/unknown and positive-outgoing explanations separately from no-outgoing equality. Negative components are mismatches, never clipped. Unknown plausible outgoing vector/source/owner or incomplete census must be UNKNOWN for complete accounting; an observed-only arithmetic equality may be reported separately without calling it complete. Supplemental window accounting uses unique first-observed signatures over0..2; do not use future outgoing as proof of same-tick cause.
false_explanation: Keep every MATCH and ZERO case. Count outgoing-positive accounting disagreements and unknowns, plus frozen source/owner/vector/time negative controls; do not search a favorable subset of outgoing vectors. No-outgoing MATCH equality alone is not positive continuation evidence.
gate: STRONG_CONTINUATION_PATTERN only if primary complete accounting exact >=90% of the 21 original scored holdout captures (UNKNOWN remains in denominator), and outgoing-positive exact precision >=90% with at least10 positive explained conservative groups in >=2 contexts; no causal or predictive production credit. Otherwise explicitly report FALSIFIED for observable failed accounting, or INFORMATION_CEILING when missing/ambiguous visibility prevents deciding. H1 alone cannot decide.
before_trigger: Only predeclared existing before fields may be explored: visible local line fact, terminal flag, capacity class, production due, inbound completeness, current source/target delay. Freeze at most one development-derived Boolean trigger before evaluating old holdout; >=90% holdout accuracy and no evident negative-control false positives are required for next-round candidate consideration, never production on these already-seen recordings. No ID/cohort/tower memorization. If all before fields are constant or UNKNOWN, no trigger exists in this bounded candidate set; stop.
